Celebrate football heritage with the Manchester United 26/27 Away Jersey. A bold nod to the iconic 1988 kit, this design channels the energy of the River Irwell, connecting the club and the landscape. Climacool technology wicks and disperses sweat for a cool, dry performance. The slim fit and V-neck offer a streamlined, versatile silhouette, while the doubleknit fabric provides durability. Embossed graphic detailing adds flair to a look that stands out on and off the pitch. With a woven club logo and our signature 3-Stripes, we add authenticity and flair. For fans who want to showcase their passion with confidence, this jersey is made to perform. Crafted with adidas' attention to the finer details, it's a statement piece featuring modern innovation.

Fit : Slimfit
